summary:
Is your PS4 saying "Unrecognised disc", refusing to eject, grinding and clicking, or beeping and spitting discs out by itself?

We repair PS4 disc drives on the original, Slim and Pro. Disc drive repairs start from R1,000 (R1,200 on the Pro), and laser replacements from R1,500.

Bring it to our workshop at Silvercrest Shopping Centre in Silvamonte, or we collect anywhere in Gauteng for a flat R300, insured both ways.

The diagnostic is free, you get the price before we start, and every repair carries a 6-month warranty.

Tap Book to arrange your repair with us.
